effects: Local unknowns may resolve within a supported partial obligation; full completeness still requires all obligations answered and no retained unknown.
Keep individually supported same-obligation claims as partial after a local target filter empties a redundant summary.
No LLM navigation rewrite for a coverage-recovery-only gap; real explicitly asked gaps retain the existing path.
Reserve a current confirmed section directory and first four bounded paragraph groups for broad survey queries.
At most two full complementary facts per group replace background within the existing64candidate/24reference/36000char caps.
Source groups are navigation metadata; source positions, revision and current eligibility remain required.

limitations: Same fixed regression questions already used in development; not a blind test.
New extraction and model randomness prevent causal attribution from between-attempt score differences.
A named work and one complementary fact do not guarantee every reported method or effect is included.
Count-scope over-expansion and absence-based negative answers still require semantic model review; no untested lexical bypass was added.
